summary: D.C. has secured a victory against the Trump administration regarding voter rolls, while advocates continue highlighting threats to D.C.'s autonomy and fiscal independence. Recent events involving federal control of the District—including deployment of National Guard troops and a Guard-related event—have renewed calls from statehood and home rule organizations for greater local self-governance, with DC Vote urging Congress to reject measures that would limit D.C.'s fiscal authority.
